description: Implementation of ContentDao for handling content retrieval and management in a sales manager system; interacts with database via QueryDSL and JPA.

classes.name: ContentDaoImpl
classes.description: Data access implementation for Content entity, providing methods to query content by type, code, language, store, and other criteria.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Returns list of Content objects filtered by type, store, and optionally language.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Returns list of ContentDescription objects containing name and URL for content filtered by type, store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a Content entity by its code and store.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves Content by its ID and Language.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves Content entity by its ID.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches Content by code, store, and language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves ContentDescription by store and SEO URL.
